data.text: The Secret Stan Life of a Diva
【Autumn Date with High-Spec Me Robocosan】Live Start
【Whimsical Steps, Dressed to Shine Pekora】Live Start
【Vibrant Shower of Fallen Gold Nene】Live Start
【The Breeze of Ginkgo Trees Reine】Live Start
【Autumn Date with High-Spec Me Robocosan】SP Skill
【Whimsical Steps, Dressed to Shine Pekora】SP Skill

What a great view. Hey, look! The pond is bright red! Let's scoop up those fallen leaves floating over there. Hmm, just a little more... W-Woah?! Oh, thank you... If you hadn’t propped me up, I would have fallen in the pond... Eh? You think I looked like a cute kid? Hmph, I'm a big girl! Hajime and Anya told me I was responsible, sooo... Anyway moving on, I bought some warm drinks and sandwiches. Wanna have some? ...Really?! Let's sit over there and eat!
Get smitten with me in my stylish autumn outfit~♪
Take a look at this fluffy white cardigan! Cute, right~?♪
The coffee is piping hot, so be careful handling it... Woah, it's even hotter than I thought?!
This sandwich is yummy! Hm, I have sauce on my mouth? Get it off for me~
Thanks for the food! Phew, that was filling~♪ Sooo, what are we gonna do next~?
That was a huge yawn~ Are you sleepy? Here, you can rest your head in my lap~♪

Awoooo!! Matsuri the wolf is hereeeee!
...Just kidding~♪ This is the outfit I wore for the outfit party! Cute, right?
...But ya'know, I'm bored... Why do you keep looking at me?
Oh come on, I know what you want to say. You want to take care of me, right?
Okay, then! Start by stroking my head and calling me a good girl.
Come on, do it already~♪
I'm a wolf, and if you take your eyes off me, you'll be in trouble♡
Let your guard down and this wolf might just eat ya♡ Awoooo~♪
Ah, I'm so sleepy... Come lounge around over here with me~
You're amazing to cuddle with~ Ebifrion and Matsuri-chan, the fluffy pair!
Huh, you wanna pet that cat? No, if you wanna pet someone, pet me!
Hmph, don't hold back and stroke away~ Matsuri the wolf will nurse you back to health♡

Hmm, what a great view! The ginkgo trees I saw earlier were nice, but the maple leaves are beautiful, too. The leaves are shaped like stars, how funny... Hehe, how do I look? I put in a hair accessory. Does it suit me, peko? ...What's with that expression? It's like you've seen something rare! I'm not getting all hyper about it... I just thought the shape was pretty... H-Hmph! Stop staring at me! Look at the maple leaves instead~!
Carrots are the color of autumn! So, does that mean it's Peko-ra season?
A chic black rabbit isn't so bad every once in a while, huh?
This scene with the maple leaves dancing in the wind... Hmm, I could write a nice poem about it, peko~♪
Let's take a peek at that stall... I wonder what they have~♪
Oh, hold up! There's a maple leaf stuck in your hair, stay still... Okay, got it!
It's nice to just cruise around every once in a while. If you invite me again, I'll definitely come!

Look at all the leaves I've collected... Whooosh! All the leaves fluttering down, so exquisite... Oh, this park? I found it on the way back from shopping with everyone the other day! I had too much baggage so I couldn't stop by. I'm glad I could today! All right, I'm all psyched up! Starting now, let's play a game of dodge the falling leaves! You win by getting through the row of trees without getting hit! Okay, ready?! Whooooo~!
Autumn is all about sports! Everyone, let's get the party started with infinite jumping~!
How do I look? Bet you're obsessed with my autumn fashion?
Watch me gallivanting through the glistening ginkgo trees... Hmm, so picturesque~♪
I wonder if there are any rare bugs under the leaves? Wanna help me look?
Let's take a break on the bench! Come sit down next to me~♡
Tada! Lemme give you a ginkgo leaf to remember today by! Remember it's from me and take good care of it!♡

After brushing my teeth...next is getting changed...
And it’s still TOO early. Y’know? Moona and Iofi suddenly said they wanted to go for a walk this early!
I know that staying at a lodging is fun and all...but they need to chill!
Honestly, getting this hyped for a walk this early... How childish can they be?
Oh well, I guess BIG SIS here will have to play along!♪
Hehehe~♪ What kind of mischief can WE get into today? Let’s brainstorm while we get ready!
If you relax too much, I might just have to play a little prank on you! Hehe~♪
Opinions on this eye mask? It looks just like me! Super duper cute!
Still feeling sleepy? Okay, leave it to me... Sudden-death Wake Up Tickle Attack!
Where did I put my change of clothes again... Oh, you found them? Big thanks!
On my signal, we barge into Moona and Iofi’s room. Hehehe...
It really energizes me to have someone with me from sunrise! Alright, let’s have tons of fun today!

Ohhh... This really hits the spot! Nothing can beat a nice bathing session after playing this much!
Spending time under the same roof as Risu and Yopi... How nostalgic! It’s like we’re back to when we lived together.
By the way, thanks for heating up the water! The temperature was perfect!♪ Hehe.
Are you heading back to your room? I mean, that’s totally fine, but...if you don’t mind, I’d like you to stay by the door a little longer...
I-It’s just that I really enjoy talking to you...
Just a bit more? Please, just a bit more!
Moon Moon! A cute Moona will appear in everyone’s dreams tonight!
After bath time I usually put on these fluffy pajamas~♪ What? You wanna see them now?
Munya, munya... AH! That was close! I almost dozed off 'cause these feel so nice...
Are you able to hear my voice? If you want, you can come a little bit closer to the door, you know~
Ah! I forgot my bath towel... Sorry to ask this, but could you bring one to me?
I was having so much fun chatting that I might’ve gotten a bit lightheaded... I wanna do this again soon, though!♪

Oh? Helloooo!
This lodge gets such great sunlight I can’t fight basking in it...
I-It’s okay to be a little lazy sometimes, okay? I bet Risu and Moona are doing the exact same thing too!♪
The three of us staying in the same place really brings back memories of when we used to live together.
Hihi, being able to repeat those moments is something really dear to me!♪
Hehe, now I kind of feel like chatting with Risu and Moona~♪
I’ll laze around a lil’ bit more then head over there!♡
Let’s meet in our dreams too, okay? Pinky☆swear☆
How do you like these? Did your heart skip a beat? Hehehe~♪
Once I lie down, it’s hard to get back up... How terrifying can the warmness of the sun can be?
Zzz... Zzz... Just kidding! I’m awake!
Wanna lie down together? There’s plenty of space, so come on~♪
I had so much fun today!♪ Let’s sunbathe together again~♡

Ta-da! Look at these ginkgo trees! Give it a bit more time and the ground will be totally covered in leaves, the whole place turns bright yellow!
...Well, at least that’s what it said in the guidebook!
Hehe, aren't I a good girl? I actually did my homework! I mean, you did invite me out, so it’s the least I could do, right?
Anyway! I’m done being the guide. Now it’s your turn to take the lead!
I went through all the trouble of getting this fit approved by Marine-senpai, so you better make sure I have a blast, okay? Hehe...
I’m gonna magic some color into your fall! Let’s get it~
This stole is such a serve, right? Totally fits the whole 'peafowl princess' vibe!
Time to dive straight into that giant pile of leaves! DIIIIVE~♪ ...Ehe! Ahaha, just kidding!
Pfft, you’ve got a leaf on your head~ Here, hold still while I get it for you.
Whew, it’s getting a bit chilly~ Wanna grab something warm at that cafe over there?
Thanks for showing me around today! My rating? A literal 10/10! Ehehe~

TA-DA! Look what I wore to that costume party recently!
It suits me? Well, of course it would♪
Okaaay, since you said some nice things, I’ll perform a little checkup on you! Let’s see here...
At a glance... you seem to be missing some screws up there! Yep, treatment time~
A big ol’ syringe is all we need! Brace yourself, ’cause it’s gonna sting!
Oiii! Don’t you dare to try to run away! Be a good boy and stay still♪
Keeheehee... Just kidding!
I’m gonna prescribe everyone a couple special shows to heal your hearts♪
Wrapping bandages on yourself is pretty hard! But what I did here is a masterpiece, right?
You’ve got quite a few problem areas besides your head, huh? Onto the examination room!
As for the next step, I’ll listen to your heartbeat with this stethoscope... Found it.
WO-AH! I wonder what’s with your heartbeat...♪ It’s cause I’m this close to you?
Finished. Let’s play ag...I mean, come back whenever you need another chekup! Get well soon, my dear patient!

Woah, the whole place smells like straight-up grapes! It's everywhere~
And it's all-you-can-eat?! This is literally paradise. The view is so pretty, too!
...Wait! I totally should've brought my new acrylic stands to see the view... Ugh, what a waste!
Well, whatever, next time! Forget that, let's just go all out on these fall treats~
C'mon, let's get picking! We’re gonna stuff this basket till it’s overflowing!
And then...we're gonna have ourselves a total feast!
Since it’s fall, I’m gonna make you all fall for my singing!♪ Ready?
So? How's the fall fit? I'm totally pulling it off, right? Right??
Nnngh! Almost...there... Just gotta...reach those grapes... WHOA, CRAP!
Thanks for catching me! Anyway, we've got a literal mountain of grapes now, so let's just start eating already!
Shooo good! I'm obsessed with this sweetness. Wait, that one's huge! Gimme a bite!
Hey, hey! We’re totally going on another fall food run together, okay? It’s a promise! Deal?

Done! Here’s Magical☆Love☆Witch☆Nerissa’s specially made energy drink!
Ingredients are...secret♡ But I’ve been simmering them with love for three days straight, so I’m sure the results are exceptionally high!
Hm? Dressed like this I seem like a real witch closing in on you, you say? Are you frightened by this presence?
N-No, that’s not it! I just wanted to wear it again since I used only once for a costume party...  Huh, the other way around? You mean...it suits me?
Thank goodness! Hm... As for my next spell... This Love Witch will feed you the drink with lots of love♡
C’mon! Open your mou~th... Here, say ahh~♡
I’ll cast a little spell to make you cheer harder!
You are slowly...but surely...falling in love with me. HOWSTHAT? Did it work?
How’s the drink? Tastes great, right? I’ve plenty of ‘em, so drink as much as you’d like! Fufufu♪
And here’s your refill♪ AGHHH! I’ve just went and spilled it all...
Thank you for helping me clean up this mess... As a reward, I’ll grant you a wish♡
Oh? What do we have here? Your face is so red! OH!? COULD IT BE!? You finally fell prey to my spell♡

Hah-haha! Flocks of bats swarm around at night! And the monster's name is...Vampire Raden~! 
...Yes, that's my farcical backstory! Ahahaha~♪
Huh, this outfit? This is the costume I wore to the costume party~♪
Anyway, since you came to hang out together, why don't we have a drink!
Here, a nice thick glass of tomato juice!
Of course I wouldn't serve you blood! Raise up your glass with me!
Ready? To this night's moon... Cheers~♪
Please enjoy every drop of this delight, brought to you by a cheerful vampire!
Check out these chic tones! Gothic fashion is great, right?
Vegetables are good for your health! So I'm going to have another glass of tomato juice~♪
If I drink like this from a wine glass... I can get drunk on vibes alone?! Wuahaha~♪
My stomach is all bloated... I shouldn't have gulped it all down...
I've shown myself up... Let's start afresh! Let's go look at the moon shining together.

Tada, coshtume change complete~!
Actually, this ish the outfit I wore to the coshtume party. I wore it becaushe I wanted to show it to everyone.
What do you shink? I look good in it, right?
...Huh, it'sh cute? Hey-hey-hey, you mean I am cool, right?
Hmph, well then I'll put on a cool performance and everyone will tell me that "Banchou, you're cool!"
All right, here we go! Mushic, shtart~♪
Hop~♪ Hop~♪ Hop~♪ Let'sh do the Jiangshi danshe together~!
It'sh Banchou Jiangshi Todoroki Hajime! Hop-hop-hop~♪
I wanna do the Jiangshi Dance wish everyone... Will anyone be my partnah?!
Wave both your handsh to the beat! Get redy... To the right~♪ To the left~♪
Amazing! You learnt the movesh so quickly! We're already shet to perform!
Hop-hop-hop~♪ Ahaha, we're in shync~♪ Everyone'sh an amazing Jiangshi dancer~♪
I'll welcome everyone with my fluffy knit sweater~♪
I'll take a bite out of you if you don't~♡
I'm a fluffy wolfie, give me attention~♪
Let's go! One, two, and home free on three!
Autumn is the season of good food, art, and live shows!
Yeahhh! Riding the autumn breeze, Momosuzu Nene has arrived~♪
This excitement I’m feeling isn’t a dream!
Oomph! This is what I call a good rest!
I feel like I can sing in a really relaxed way today!♪
We’re together whether asleep or awake!♡
Today’s show is going to be really chill. Welcome, everyone!
Mep mep mep! Fall season in here!
Alrighty, time for a health check!
How are you holding up? No worries, you’ll feel better with Zeta’s show♪
Bringing that fall energy to the stage now!
How about I teach you some love spells?
Who’s ready to be captivated by my spells?♡
Now, witness! The dazzling show that lights the dark night is about to begin~!
Hajime is the Jiangshi Bancho! Follow me!
Autumn is a great season to enjoy fashion, isn't it?
Look, Lap! I found a huge maple leaf!
How about we jump out of a pile of leaves for our next show?
Hajime~! What comes to mind when you think of autumn~?
Ehehe, I wonder if I can take Choco-sensei's heart too?
Hey! You'll snag the sweater with those horns!
Aww, thank you~♪ Did I set your heart on fire?
Ehehe, it's great, right? Wanna try it on?
Get smitten with me in my stylish autumn outfit~♪
Hey, cute peafowl over there! I will make your wish come true!
Hey! You literally can eat those all year round!
You can do whatever you like...to my paws~♡
Wagging my tail swish-swish♪ You guys totally dig this kind of stuff, right?
Found me some unsuspecting prey! Dinner time~♪
You want to know if you can make me your pet?!
Uaaaah... You've got me wrapped around your finger~
It totally is, you can hug me if you like~♪
I'm a wolf, and if you take your eyes off me, you'll be in trouble♡
Wow~♪ That garter belt is cute~♪
Really...? It must be from seeing how cute you are, Zeta~♪
Nerissa-chan, please, cast your spell of love on me!
Did an adorable witch just call for me?
Vampires sleep in coffins, right? I wanna climb in one too~!
A hug from Matsuri~? Let's test it out~♪
Are you feeling cold? Shall I warm you up for you~?!
You are having fun, aren't you, lil' Jiangshi~♪
Oh, Peko-chan! You're all dressed up~♪
You're having a blast, aren't ya~?♪
Oh my, the heart design is so cute!♡
Peko-chan, have you discovered your yandere side?!
Oh, your outfit is stylish, Nene!
All right, wanna try spinning for 30 minutes?
Today, I'm all frilly and fluffy~♪
No no, I'll leave that in AZ-chan's capable hands!
A quiet, cool breeze heralds the arrival of autumn... I don't hate it.
Since I'm here, I'd like a better feel for autumn.
This is making me nostalgic. How about you girls?!
Autumn is a great time of year~♪
Carrots are the color of autumn! So, does that mean it's Peko-ra season?
Ooh, look at you pulling off the chic coat vibe~
Don't fight it~ Holding back is bad for your health, you know~?
Hanging out with us will make you 100 times more hyper!
Pekoraccho, you're cute like a doll~♪
Reine! I'm gonna get this place red-hot!
Of course I love it, what kind of question is that?!
Nene, your outfit is just perfect for going out!
Hah, how utterly naive! I can evade them easily!
Ooh, that outfit actually makes you look like an adult, nanora.
Nna~i! It’s IRyS and Nnatan, nanora!
Gimme some more! Tell me once a day!
W-Wait! You mean you want to go on a date with me?!
Finisher! Leaf Shuriken!! Whoosh whoosh whoosh~☆
I'm hungry so I might have some air-roasted sweet potato!
Fall is the season of the arts! Soooo...it's time to start the "Ina-chan Appreciation Session"~
Why did the apple pie go to the dentist? Because it needed a filling!
I mean, you’re welcome to come "check" it out a little closer?
Autumn is all about sports! Everyone, let's get the party started with infinite jumping~!
Give us an autumn-themed joke, and make it good!
Hey, mine's even bigger! I win~♪
I like that knit sweater you're wearing. Lemme have a feel~!
Let Moona’s light shine on you if you start to feel sleepy!♪
Ehehe... I’ll make this a dreamlike show!♡
To keep ‘em close in case I get the munchies... Just kidding!♪
Hehehe... It’s just that these are so comfy, I can’t help but relax...
If you relax too much, I might just have to play a little prank on you! Hehe~♪
And for the next trick, Imma lower Moona’s eye mask!
Hmm!! Your shoulder straps look SO sexy~♡
Ahhh~ And it's rubbing off on me too!♪
Leave it to me! SHINING BEEEEAM!
WHY do you have so many acorns in your pajamas?!
You ACTUALLY know what’s gonna happen to you, right?
Risu! This Fluffy Moona will wrap you up and never let you go!
I know, right? Wanna try touching it? Hehehe~♪
Moon Moon! A cute Moona will appear in everyone’s dreams tonight!
And the star-shaped patch looks so cute too!♪
It won’t be a secret at all if we talk here though?!
Hah, there are too many delicious temptations~
And I’ll add the sweetness it needs~♡
Get it together, Risu! You can’t sleep all the way to the start of our show!
Moona’s pajama looks so fluffy and comfy!
I KNEW you’d get it, Risu!
Riiight? Isn’t this the perfectest outfit to stand beside the Moon Goddess?
Ahhh~ Oopsie! Idols are not supposed to yawn like this, hehe~♪
Pajama talk time! Moona, let’s share some spicy secrets!♪
Let’s meet in our dreams too, okay? Pinky☆swear☆
Gotta be careful we don't get grilled when somebody lights a bonfire...
Whoa, Roboco-senpai, how pretty you are!
Hey, IRyS~ Give me some manga recs.
Look at you, totally slaying those fall fits.
Then take me to my favorite autumn spots~♪
Yay! Let's dispel the autumn breeze with song and dance~♪
Let's blame it on autumn and enjoy gourmet food~♪
When you think of fall food...you think of SPICY NOODLES!
You like this girl in her gorgeous autumn style?
Look here! A peafowl bringing autumn...Pavolia Reine has arrived!
Letting my stole flutter in the wind~ Here’s a mesmerizing dance just for you~♡
Bet. And obviously, the theme is fall vibes only!
I’m gonna magic some color into your fall! Let’s get it~
A wolf, huh...? I wonder if I can take care of one?
M-Matsuri-oneechan, it's embarrassing when you stare at me like that~!
Matsuri-oneechan your face is red! Do you have a fever?
Wanna guess what’s inside this little waist bag?
Not white, but a black-robed angel has arrived~♪
A cool Banchou like you isn't afraid of needles, right~?
Oh, well♪ If something happens, I’ll nurse you back to health♪
I’m gonna prescribe everyone a couple special shows to heal your hearts♪
Is there any spell to avoid any PON moments?
Meowww’r you making me do! Stop it!
Oooh, that outfit really makes the wine red pop~♪
Ahaha~♪ Maybe I should smile even more~?
I think I'll write "Genius Zeta" on this talisman~♪
So cute it's giving me chills~♪
Is... Is this...the legendary peafowl courtship dance?!
Weine! Put your best fit on, 'cause we’re having a style-off right now!
U-uh, if you stare at me that much, I'm gonna get embarrassed...
Whoa~ that plaid skirt is so cute on you!
Right?! Don't stop now, I can handle more compliments!
Hey! What’s that supposed to mean? I'm not an adult normally?
Gotchu! Here’s a top-tier pick for 'Reading Season'~
Fall's a dangerous season... It’s just way too full of tasty temptations!
So, who’s bringing us the perfect music for this "Artistic Fall"?
This weather is so nice, it makes me want to dress up even more~
Hey, check out my fall fit, pretty cute, right?
Uh, yeah... I think I’ll pass on the whole 'Athletic Fall' thing...
Since it’s fall, I’m gonna make you all fall for my singing!♪ Ready?
IRyS, IRyS! Let’s have a race!
Aww, so cute! I’m living for this!
I could honestly just sit here and pet you forever♡
Is it cat food by any chance?♪
I-I’m fainting here guys... Zeta-senpai is way too adorable...
Matsuri-senpai is so close! CAN’T. CONCEN. TRATE. *gulps*
Why would WE need that? Your clumsiness itself is a source of magic!
Mirror, mirror on the wall, who’s Matsuri-senpai’s favorite witch?
And with my next spell...I’ll turn Zeta-senpai into a REAL cat!
So, did I, the greatest witch, win you over?
Your dance there was the peak of magics!
You okay there? Do you need some magical assistance?
I’m glad I precasted a smiling spell beforehand. Ufufufu♪
I’ll cast a little spell to make you cheer harder!
That lipstick color is gorgeous! It goes so well with your outfit too♡
Fufu... Totally showing off your wings for everyone, huh? So cute♡
You there, little spirit with the sharp moves! Let's dance together♪
Fufu... Oh, Hajime-chan, look at you hopping around, so adorable♡
Hold on! Are you pretending to be me?!
If I stick in one more carrot, no one will notice...
Aaaaaah~?! Don't just cling onto me~!
Wow, so soft to the touch! Like a cuddly toy!
Why all the bandages anyway? Just how injured can you get?!
As expected of you! Oh my, what a commanding look♪
I hope today’s MC lands well!
Go ahead! I'll be sleeping in a different coffin.
This is split tomato juice... Just kidding!
Gasp! I sense a compliment coming my way! Yaaay!
A quiz for you! What's a vampire's weakness?
Zeta-senpai's smile is so bright?! It'll turn me into ash~
Check it out, everyone! Watch me fly through the sky with these wings!
Wuahaha~! I've come for your blood~!
That's right! But personally, I prefer some good old alcohol over blood!
Please enjoy every drop of this delight, brought to you by a cheerful vampire!
Those dangling sleeves are a danger... All right, let's fasten them for you!
No~! That'll seal away my wild side!
Where did thish tail shprout from...?
Zeta-shenpai, you shuld eat yor vegetablesh for your health.
We are not done yet! Shtick with me ‘till the end!
Nerissha’s shongs are like magic itshelf...
Raden, you've really got into sharacter~♪
Vampiresh shtay healshy by drinking blood, right?
Nyan?! Your eyesh are shcarier than mine~!
Wheee~ I'm gonna dance wif Nerissa-neesan wif all my mighties!
Quit it~! I won be able to ushe my handsh then!
Grr-grr~♪ Look at my dangling shleeves~♪
I'm not any old Jiangshi... I'm shuper-duper shcary!
Nerissa-neesan, let's go pway and boing-boing together~
Wanna put on matching talismansh, Raden?
Hop~♪ Hop~♪ Hop~♪ Let'sh do the Jiangshi danshe together~!
